name: HADES
summary: HADES is based at GSI Helmholtzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung, Darmstadt. This multipurpose strong-interaction and nuclear-physics experiment supports dark-sector searches through its dilepton capabilities.
detection_principle: Inclusive e⁺e⁻ spectra from proton and ion collisions test new narrow resonances in radiative meson decays; different collision systems control ordinary hadronic-decay backgrounds.

results.summary: The dark-photon search found no significant mass peak and constrained photon–U mixing.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
